title: Connecting to the New Wi-Fi
context: 新住户 Nina 和室友 Owen 根据路由器标签连接家庭网络并确认连接成功。 本课为 2026-11-22 预制系列原创练习，并非真实考试题。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: I cannot find our new Wi-Fi network on my laptop.
dialogue.zh: 我的笔记本电脑找不到新家的无线网络。

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.en: The router is on. What network names can you see?
dialogue.zh: 路由器开着。你能看到哪些网络名称？

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: I see one called Maple Home and another called Maple Guest.
dialogue.zh: 我看到一个叫 Maple Home，另一个叫 Maple Guest。

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.en: Maple Home is ours. The name is on the label under the router.
dialogue.zh: Maple Home 是我们的。路由器底部的标签上有名称。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Found it. Is the password on that label, too?
dialogue.zh: 找到了。密码也在标签上吗？

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.en: Yes. Be careful: the last character is a number, not a letter.
dialogue.zh: 是的。注意，最后一个字符是数字，不是字母。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Thanks. I will type it again slowly.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我会再慢慢输入一遍。

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.en: Does the laptop say it is connected now?
dialogue.zh: 笔记本电脑现在显示已连接吗？

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Yes, but let me open a page to check.
dialogue.zh: 显示了，不过让我打开网页确认一下。

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.en: Good idea. My phone connected earlier, so the network is working for me.
dialogue.zh: 好主意。我的手机刚才连上了，所以网络在我这边是正常的。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: The page loaded. I must have typed the password wrong before.
dialogue.zh: 网页加载出来了。我之前肯定是输错密码了。

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.en: Glad it works. Keep the password private when guests visit.
dialogue.zh: 能用了就好。客人来时注意保管好密码。

expressions.zh: 网络名称，用来辨认要连接的网络。
expressions.example: The network name appears on the screen.
The model number is on the label.
Open a page to test your connection.

expressions.zh: 加载，指网页内容显示出来。
expressions.example: The page took a moment to load.

pronunciation: router 在美式英语中常读作 ROW-ter；password 重音在第一音节。

practice.title: Part 1 · Internet
practice.prompt: What do you usually use the internet for at home?
practice.answer: I use it to talk with family, read the news, and watch short videos in the evening.

practice.title: Part 2 · Solving a small problem
practice.prompt: Describe a small problem with a device that you solved. Say what happened, what you tried, and how it ended.
practice.answer: When I moved into a new apartment, my laptop would not connect to the Wi-Fi. My roommate showed me the network name and password on the router label. I noticed that I had entered a letter where there was a number. I typed the password again and opened a page to test it. The page loaded, and I felt relieved that we had found the mistake. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Technology
practice.prompt: Why can simple instructions make technology easier to use?
practice.answer: Clear instructions help people find the next step without feeling lost. They can also prevent small mistakes that waste time.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读确认网络名称和密码的句子，再描述如何检查连接。
practice.answer: I can see the network name on the label. I will type the password carefully and open a page to check the connection.
